dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: When you put it like that...

dialogues.speaker: Rikas
dialogues.text: See, now you're listening! Trust me, everything else is a waste of time — once you've got houses, you've got everything you need.

dialogues.speaker: Rikas
dialogues.text: I can tell just by looking at you that you're here in Nasha Town to make something of yourself! Take my advice, save up some money, and buy a house right here — the prices have a long way to rise!

dialogues.speaker: Rikas
dialogues.text: If you put your money into anything else, just be careful you don't get rinsed for everything you own. That's what's happened to most of those folks down at the square.
